anchor_b_chargestate.status: DONE (single-point, fixed-geometry) - charged barrier 127 meV vs neutral 141 meV, ratio 0.90
anchor_b_chargestate.interpretation: On the SAME (MACE-relaxed neutral) geometry, removing one electron (V_I+ vs V_I0) LOWERS the barrier ~14 meV (10%). This is the electronic-energy response at FIXED nuclei, NOT the order-of-magnitude separation Tyagi 2025 reports - that requires charged-cell GEOMETRY RELAXATION / charged NEB (the charged vacancy relaxes to a different structure). This single-point result is a first look; full charge-state validation needs a relaxed charged path.
anchor_b_chargestate.background_note: QE neutral background auto-added for tot_charge=+1; cancels in barrier E(saddle)-E(init) since both geoms share cell+charge, so no FNV needed for barrier heights
